A.title: Hum in the Stone
A.text: In the heart of the cavern the stones sing when you walk past. Stop moving and they quiet. Speed makes them louder, and louder is worse.

Y.title: Veins That Ring
Y.text: Crystal veins run through the walls. They give back every blow you strike, and a hard blow comes back hard. Strike light near them. Strike true.

R.title: The Last Tuner
R.text: The last tuner wrote that a cavern keeps one note. Find it, hum it low, and your qi settles into it. Do not hold it long. It wants to be held.

G.title: Silence Room
G.text: The one quiet room in the choir. The stones here stay still, and the tuners came here to rest their ears. Rest yours.

M.title: Choir Order
M.text: Painted on the wall, a seating plan. Sopranos by the east stones, bass by the west. Somebody has moved the bass. It sounds wrong, and that is why.

O.title: Tuning Fork, Left Behind
O.text: An iron fork, dented. Strike it and the room answers a half tone sharp. The tuners hated that. They never fixed it.

U.title: Singing Stones
U.text: The stones hum a different note in each passage. Follow the rising notes and you go deeper. Follow the falling ones and you come out.

X.title: A Weaver's Thread
X.text: Weavers once ran thread between the stones to hold the notes steady. The thread rotted, and the notes drift. The balance was theirs to keep. It was always work.
